connector.name: MCP by snapdiff.ai
connector.registryDescription: Visual-diff & change-detection tools that catch agentic UI drift for coding agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package snapdiff-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.snapdiff. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SNAPDIFF_API_KEY

env.name: SNAPDIFF_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.snapdiff.ai/v1.
